rules.clues: clues in reveal order; position = slot the letter fills
rules.places: the whole countries map of North America: letters in the 10 countries of section 6 (in the main part of the country, the circle wholly inside the border; a country too small for that takes no letter), on the 13 rivers of section 2 («on the Mississippi») and on a river inside a country it crosses («on the Rio Grande in Mexico»), and on the objects of section 1 (not the Bering and Denmark straits); at least a third of the letters on rivers (Svetlana, 28.10.2026). Lakes, mountains and deserts are not drawn on this map; the Caribbean island states are on their own map
rules.nesting: as b4-section-6.json: a country named once per puzzle; one letter per river; «on the Mississippi» never with a country the Mississippi crosses; a country or a river in it never with its island or peninsula; no letter inside the area of another place
rules.spacing: hypot(dx, dy * 1600/2200) >= 10 (% of map width; at 9 two tap areas can overlap on the whole map)
rules.languages: RU and EN are laid out separately; each layout is checked on its own by this tool (check())
rules.role: block-final: the final GeoWords of the block 4 review (passport stamp)
rules.approval: same as section-1.json: the approval covers answer, markers, clues, map, mapAspect, layers, language and showInsets
